# HGNC nomenclature reference

The compressed file in this directory contains the HGNC complete set exactly
as used in the reference analysis. It is a nomenclature reference with no patient or
tumour records. Its uncompressed SHA-256 is

`6df77ac3cbaeb86a6dce5e17d851ebb27b6b3cdcd2471a211a3d8464f00c54c4`.

Source and attribution are to the HUGO Gene Nomenclature Committee. See its
[download archive](https://hgnc.genenames.org/download/archive/) and
[license statement](https://hgnc.genenames.org/about/license/). The original
HGNC data are under [CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/).
The repository supplies the bundled reference because the current download
changes across releases. The reference analysis recorded the checksum and original
filename. An upstream dated release identifier was unavailable.
